# LumAIa – The Agentic Agency Platform for E-Commerce

> LumAIa makes online shops agent-ready for the era of AI shopping agents.
> 100% Agent-Ready. 100% Brand Safety. Unlimited Scalability. 90% Cost Reduction.

## About

LumAIa is an AI-powered platform that makes e-commerce product catalogs visible and selectable for autonomous AI shopping agents (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity). It unifies strategy, production, and campaign optimization in one system – translating agency expertise into software.

## Company

- Name: LumAIa (by Dewave GmbH)
- Website: https://lumaia.studio
- Location: Switzerland
- Contact: hello@lumaia.ai

## Platform Phases

1. **Plan** – Market analysis, personas, media strategy, budget planning
2. **Build** – Asset creation (banners, copy, visuals, landing pages, emails, product images)
3. **Publish** – Automated campaign launch, budget control, real-time optimization
4. **Report & Learn** – Attribution, management reports, learning feedback loop

## Product Asset Studio (Live)

Turns a single product image into a complete set of hero, lifestyle, detail, and micro-rotation assets – EU AI Act compliant with C2PA provenance records and Fidelity Scoring. Makes product catalogs machine-readable and agent-ready at scale.

## Agentic Commerce

Agentic commerce is shopping through autonomous AI agents – they search, compare, and buy on behalf of consumers without human guidance. Online shops must meet three prerequisites to be visible to these agents:

1. **Structured product data** – Schema.org, clean and complete attributes
2. **Compliant image assets** – C2PA provenance, EU AI Act compliant, verifiable
3. **Technical accessibility** – Open interfaces, crawler access, protocol support

Five protocols shape this process: ACP (purchase processes), UCP (structured product data), MCP (AI model data access), AP2 (secure agent payments), A2A (agent-to-agent communication).

Product Asset Studio addresses prerequisite #2 – delivering compliant, verifiable image assets at catalog scale.

## Pricing

- Self-Serve: From CHF 29/month (e.g., Product Asset Studio)
- Pilot Partner: 12-month fixed price with full module access
